english.title: Drive a hackney carriage plying for hire within metropolitan police district or city of London without section 8 licence
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP...) drove a hackney carriage, namely **(..SPECIFY HACKNEY CARRIAGE..), which plied for hire within the limits of the

(A)_[metropolitan police district]_
(B)_[city of London]_
(C)_[metropolitan police district and the city of London]_

when you did not have a licence under section 8 of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869 from Transport for London
english.legislation: Contrary to section 8(3)(a) of the Metropolitan Public Carriage Act 1869.
